# Code of conduct

GitMorning is a small project, and we want everyone who joins in to feel welcome, whatever their experience, background, or language. Korean and English are both fine everywhere.

## Expected

- Be kind and assume good intent. Questions from newcomers are welcome.
- Discuss the work, not the person. Disagree with reasons.
- Respect people's time: keep issues and pull requests focused, and say when you cannot continue.

## Not accepted

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory language.
- Personal attacks, trolling, or deliberately derailing a discussion.
- Publishing someone's private information without permission.
- Spam, including unrelated promotion or AI-generated issues and pull requests that nobody checked.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close issues or pull requests, and block accounts that break these rules. To report a comment, issue, or pull request, open its **⋯** menu, choose **Report content**, then **Report to repository admins**; only the maintainer sees the report. Security problems go through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ddingddong9/gitmorning/security/advisories/new).

## 한국어 요약

경험·배경·언어와 관계없이 누구나 환영합니다. 친절하게, 사람이 아니라 작업에 대해 이야기해 주세요. 괴롭힘·모욕·차별적 표현·개인정보 공개·스팸(확인하지 않은 AI 생성 이슈·PR 포함)은 허용하지 않으며, 관리자는 해당 댓글·이슈·PR을 정리하거나 계정을 차단할 수 있습니다.
